issues.issue: Was the unrepresented claimant denied procedural fairness because the RPD did not explain the generalized-risk requirement?
issues.applicant_position: Unrepresented, he was not told the legal and evidentiary requirements of generalized risk, which decided his claim.
issues.respondent_position: Self-represented claimant is not owed a higher degree of fairness; generalized risk is part of his burden, so no explanation was needed.
issues.result_quote: I find that the Applicant was not accorded procedural fairness because the RPD Member failed to reasonably inform the Applicant
